name: xanima
description: Xanima (formerly openwave): autonomic memory and agent continuity for OpenClaw agents. Injects identity, goals and query-relevant recall (with confidence and relative-time labels) into every turn, and runs the sleep system. Powered by xanima-core. 0.2.0 adds a decision ledger, versioned goals with drift detection, alignment notes and goal triggers.

agents.description: OpenClaw agent ids xanima serves, or "*" for every agent in the OpenClaw config (remote mode picks up new agents live, no restart). Local mode routes each to ~/.xanima/<id>/brain.db (or ~/.sharpwave/<id> until `xanima-server migrate` has run).

skipSystemTurns.description: Skip OpenClaw system turns (heartbeat polls, exec/cron/session-event wakes, NO_REPLY / HEARTBEAT_OK replies, memory-flush runs) on every memory-writing path: no episode, no extraction.

systemTurnPatterns.description: Extra case-insensitive regexes; a turn whose trimmed text matches is skipped like a system turn.

curatedTierDedupe.description: When true (default), pass externalMemoryActive to sharpwave-core when MEMORY.md/USER.md is present so durable identity/goals are not double-injected.

consolidationCron.description: Host cron expression for openwave:consolidation (LLM consolidation). Staggered after memory-core dreaming (0 3 * * *).

consolidationCronEnabled.description: When true (default), register openwave:consolidation on gateway_start. Still registered when dreaming is disabled.

emotionalProfile.description: Reserved for sharpwave-core's valence/arousal split (not yet shipped -- see research/emotional-memory-openclaw-integration.md proposal 3). Accepted and stored but has no runtime effect until sharpwave-core exposes these fields on computeSalience.

personaOverrides.description: Per-agent-id overrides layered over the flat config above, keyed by OpenClaw agent id (e.g. "mila"). Mirrors the agents.entries.<id> override idiom (docs/gateway/config-agents/entries-and-multi-agent.md) applied to openwave's own config. Missing keys inherit the flat value above; emotionalProfile fields are accepted ahead of the engine work that will consume them.

brainMode.description: local (default): open ~/.sharpwave/<agent>/brain.db in-process, exactly as before. remote: use the SharpWave brain service (sharpwave-server) over MCP Streamable HTTP at brainUrl; no local brain.db is opened, and local sleep, the openwave:consolidation host cron and the hourly local harvest are disabled (the service owns sleep).

brainUrl.description: Remote mode: base URL of the brain service (MCP endpoint is <brainUrl>/mcp, health is <brainUrl>/health).

brainTokenFile.description: Remote mode (preferred): path to a file containing the per-agent bearer token minted by `sharpwave-server token mint`. `~` and `{agentId}` are expanded, so one entry can serve several agents (e.g. ~/.sharpwave/tokens/{agentId}.token). Takes precedence over $OPENWAVE_BRAIN_TOKEN and brainToken.

brainToken.description: Remote mode (discouraged): inline bearer token. Prefer brainTokenFile or the OPENWAVE_BRAIN_TOKEN env var so the secret is not stored in openclaw.json. Never logged.

sharedRecall.description: Remote mode: include the shared brain (visibility shared) in per-turn recall alongside the agent private brain.

remoteTimeoutMs.description: Remote mode: per-call budget for the brain service. If the service does not answer in time the turn proceeds with no recall injected.

excludeAgents.description: Agent ids openwave never serves (applies to agents: "*" and explicit lists).

autoProvision.description: Remote mode: when a served agent has no token file, provision its brain + token on the brain service (brain_provision_agent) and write brainTokenFile ({agentId} required).

provisionTokenFile.description: Path to a brain-service token with the narrow `provision` scope (or admin), used only for autoProvision. Never logged.

rosterPollMs.description: Remote + agents:"*"/autoProvision: how often to re-read the agent list in the background (ms). 0 = only on gateway start and per turn.

beliefMetadata.description: Xanima belief metadata: confidence, source and status on every memory; low-confidence recall lines get a (?) marker and disputed ones say so.

relativeTimeLabels.description: Label recalled memories with when they were learned ("3 days ago").

selfStatus.description: Add a one-line [BRAIN: status] footer to the injection when the memory system needs attention (disputed beliefs, items flagged by sleep, sleep overdue).

lowConfidenceThreshold.description: Confidence score below which a belief counts as low confidence (marker + review flag).

sleepBeliefReview.description: Sleep flags low-confidence and contradicted beliefs for review (and keeps them out of the prune) instead of letting them silently decay.

decisionLedger.description: Decision ledger: brain_record_decision / brain_update_decision_outcome / brain_query_decisions, a light recall boost for matching decisions, and the sleep decision pass.

decisionAutoExtract.description: Draft low-confidence decisions from the agent's own first-person choices ("I'll go with X over Y because ..."). Heuristic, no LLM.

decisionLessonPromotion.description: Sleep promotes recurring / high-value lessons from resolved decisions to skill nodes.

decisionBoost.description: Activation multiplier for decisions that match the current context.

intentDriftCheck.description: Compare recent activity with active goals and flag drift: during sleep, at most once a day at turn time, or off.

driftDays.description: Days without progress before a goal counts as drifting.

goalTriggers.description: Keyword / time triggers that surface a goal when it becomes relevant.

alignmentNoteMaxTokens.description: Token cap for the injected goals block (alignment note + trigger lines).

decisionDraftTtlDays.description: Auto-extracted decision drafts that stay unconfirmed, outcome-less and unlinked this many days are soft-retired by sleep (0 = never).

lessonMergeSimilarity.description: Embedding cosine at/above which a new lesson merges into an existing skill instead of creating one (lexical fallback without embeddings).
